propositions: The documentation link checker must validate both top-level docs index membership and repository-relative Markdown links from an explicit maintained-documentation boundary.
Relative links and images must resolve from their source directories to valid targets anywhere in the repository, rejecting targets that escape the repository.
The checker must report findings with source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason for missing or out-of-repository targets.
Scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced code blocks, inline code spans, and query strings must be excluded from validation or normalized before file resolution.

Included Markdown sources span root files, .agents, .github, docs, examples/agent-skills, infra, scripts, src/rebar/_guides, src/rebar/llm/eval_specs, templates, and tests paths; excluded sources include .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, src/rebar/llm/reviewers, and tests/fixtures.
The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve must be replaced with the checker API, and documentation-policy.md must document the source boundary and parser behavior.
